ItemID: NA; Title: Rattle That Lock; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The guitar-led rock appeals, but I am more interested in blues right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After Old Sock, this feels like a natural choice for relaxed blues and familiar guitar playing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Thoughtful songwriting fits my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I would save this for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Firewatcher's Daughter; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for blues guitar today, and this is less directly connected to that mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sleepwalk - First Two Stereo Albums ORIGINAL RECORDINGS REMASTERED; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: An instrumental oldies collection is not what I want to explore this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Fool To Care; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The blues and soul direction appeals, but I would try The Breeze first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotic Eye; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its tougher rock sound fits my interest in People, Hell & Angels and makes this worth trying.
ItemID: NA; Title: Supernova; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The psychedelic direction feels less appealing than the blues-oriented records here today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Down Where the Spirit Meets the Bone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Roots-oriented songwriting interests me, but I am limiting myself to two albums this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blue & Lonesome; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Straight blues sounds appealing, but I would leave it for another visit after trying my two picks.
